releaseNote.summary: Adds the $Everyone predefined role, which matches every caller, so deny $Everyone hides a field or transition from all and allow $Everyone opens it to all.

everyonePredefinedRole.description: $Everyone is a predefined role that is Yes for every caller: with or without roles, with or without an instance loaded (also on the static no-instance path). deny $Everyone refuses everybody, allow $Everyone admits everybody; a caller holding a role named $Everyone changes nothing (decided on the grant side). Accepted on every role-grant surface (transition roles, queryRoles, availableIn roles, function roles, subflow overrides, schema x-roles) and as an allOf/anyOf child. Rejected at publish in x-masking.roles / x-encryption.roles (it would exempt every caller; also dropped at read time, fail closed) and in rowSecurity.rules[].roles (RS-E05). Matching is Ordinal: a miscased spelling ($everyone, $EVERYONE) is a publish error on every role-grant surface; only $Everyone gets this check, extending it to the existing predefined roles could reject published definitions. Collision note: a static role literally named $Everyone, held by a caller or sent in the role header, changes meaning because the predefined match runs before the static comparison; the collision is negligible. PURELY ADDITIVE otherwise.
